predicate.label: politically controls
predicate.definition: Political group X controls or gains control of political body Y.
excludes: individual leadership office without party control
ambiguous: incomplete control object or political-group identity
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: control/take-control/retain/regain/win-control; historical political control. Excludes: generic win/be-in alone; individual leadership office without party control; ordinary membership; sporting victory. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: incomplete control object or political-group identity.

rationale: Ordered roles show party-to-House/Senate control/winning as the strongest coherent cluster, amid unrelated birth/occupation paths. Retain political body and actuality limits.
